problem: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. problem: psqlODBC assumed that a table it reads keeps the definition it had when the statement was described or parsed. problem: Pydantic AI Harness's PlaywrightBrowser applies an egress policy to the requests a page makes.
